Definition: from G2332; a Thessalonican, i.e. inhabitant of Thessalonice:--Thessalonian.
BiblicalUsage: A Thessalonian is an inhabitant of Thessalonica, the Macedonian city where Paul preached. In Acts 20:4, of the Thessalonians.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the Thessalonian belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
